name: Talia Bloom
life: “I still remember my grandmother believing a remarkably innocent dog.” On Saturday, near the downtown fountain, Talia keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I broke a rung at sixteen and blamed the dog. I've brought a new one and an apology.
appearance: Talia is easy to recognize by close-cropped dark curls and fine brows over wide-set eyes. Usually dressed in a narrow-striped sweater with a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial, Talia turns fully toward the person speaking when listening.
personality: Talia has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To replace the broken rung and confess the dog's innocence.
family: Marco Bennett is Talia’s second cousin. Talia makes room at the table. Marco brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *Two names on the chart*, Marco says, “I make labels that stay readable after washing.”
connections: Ruben Choi. A childhood repair and a new small chair make different use of the same rung.

reactions.situation: A repair reveals a family name under the cushion
reactions.response: Talia invites the family to see the full name before the repair is closed.

reactions.response: Talia waits at the lit stop with them and checks whether the next service is one they can actually board.
